## Services

1. Air duct cleaning — negative-pressure HEPA cleaning of full duct system (supply, return, plenums, registers)
2. Dryer vent cleaning — lint removal from dryer to exterior cap for fire prevention
3. HVAC cleaning — evaporator coil, blower wheel, air handler interior cleaning
4. Residential air duct cleaning — home-focused service for DFW single-family homes, condos, townhomes
5. Commercial air duct cleaning — office, retail, restaurant, and multi-unit properties
6. Sanitization and deodorization — EPA-registered antimicrobial treatment after mechanical cleaning
7. Mold inspection and duct cleaning — visual inspection and thorough cleaning of mold-affected duct systems

## Pricing guidance (Dallas, TX)

- Residential air duct cleaning: $300–$600 depending on home size and vent count
- Dryer vent cleaning: $100–$175
- HVAC (coil + blower + air handler): $200–$400
- All prices confirmed after free pre-cleaning inspection — no surprise charges

## Standards and process

AL Air Duct Cleaning Dallas follows NADCA (National Air Duct Cleaners Association) guidelines:
- Negative-pressure HEPA-filtered vacuum attached to main trunk line before agitation
- All registers sealed before cleaning begins
- Full system coverage — supply ducts, return ducts, both plenums, all registers
- Pre- and post-cleaning inspection
- No health claims beyond what EPA guidance supports

## Texas regulatory context

- Mold remediation on structures requires TDLR Mold Remediation Contractor licence in Texas
- HVAC contractor work requires TDLR Air Conditioning Contractor licence
- This site notes where those licences apply and makes no unlicensed claims
